subject: Production login failure
body:
Hi team,

Production users are unable to log in after today's deployment. Please investigate this immediately. The issue affects our customer portal.

Thanks,
Dana

subject: Checkout returning 503 for all customers
body:
Since 14:05 UTC the checkout service has been returning 503 errors for all customers in production. Orders cannot be placed and we are losing revenue every minute. Please treat this as an emergency.

Marco

subject: VPN outage in the Berlin office
body:
Hello,

Nobody in the Berlin office can connect to the VPN since this morning. About 60 people are affected and cannot reach internal systems.

Regards,
Jonas

subject: Payments API latency spike
body:
We're seeing a latency spike on the Payments API in production: p95 went from 300 ms to 9 s about 20 minutes ago and many requests are timing out. Merchants are reporting failed payments.

Aisha (on-call)

subject: Possible compromised admin account
body: We detected unauthorized access to the admin console from an unknown IP address at 02:14 UTC. The account jsmith-admin was used to export customer records. Please respond urgently and confirm whether this activity is expected.

subject: it's down again
body: Hi, it's down again for everyone. Please fix ASAP.

subject: Invoice PDF shows wrong VAT amount
body:
Hi,

Steps to reproduce:
1. Create an invoice with two line items in the billing portal.
2. Download the PDF.

Expected: VAT is 19% of the net amount.
Actual: VAT is calculated on the gross amount.

Reproducible in staging with the 4.2 release candidate.

Best regards,
Elena

subject: Mobile app crashes when attaching large photos
body: The iOS app crashes every time I try to attach a photo larger than 10 MB to a support ticket. Smaller photos work fine. App version 3.8.1 on an iPhone 15.

subject: Date filter returns no results
body: In the reporting dashboard, filtering by 'Last 30 days' returns an empty table even though there is data for that period. Selecting a custom range with the same dates works. This looks like a regression from last week's update.

subject: Error when saving my profile
body: When I click Save on the profile page I get "Error code 4012: unexpected token" and my changes are not saved. I'm using Edge 131 on Windows 11.

Hi,

Could you please grant me read-only access to the Salesforce sandbox? I'm joining the CRM migration project next week.

Thanks,
Grace

Hello IT,

We have a new hire, Tomas Ruiz, starting on November 3, 2026 in Finance. Please provision a laptop, a Microsoft 365 license and access to the shared Finance mailbox before his first day.

Kind regards,

Could you please prepare the Q3 customer churn report for the leadership meeting? We need it by 2026-11-05. Please include a breakdown by region.

Thanks,
Robert

Merci,

subject: Quick favour
body: Could you please put together the numbers we talked about? Thanks.

subject: Export dashboard tables to CSV
body: It would be great if the analytics dashboard could export tables to CSV. Right now we copy them manually into a spreadsheet every week.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
body: Several of our agents work night shifts and have asked for a dark mode in the support console. Is this on the roadmap?

subject: Bulk user import
body: Could you add support for importing users in bulk from a spreadsheet in the admin portal? Adding 200 users one by one takes hours.

subject: Chat notifications for pending approvals
body: We would love an option to receive chat notifications when an approval is waiting for us. Email notifications are easy to miss.

body: Hi team, circling back on the SSO integration we discussed in September. Where do we stand? We'd like to plan our rollout.

body: Searching for 'José' in the customer directory returns no results, but searching for 'Jose' finds the record. I would expect both to work. Not urgent, but it confuses our agents.

body: Since the daylight saving change, weekly totals in the timesheet app are one hour higher than the sum of the daily entries. Example: 8+8+8+8+8 shows 41 hours.
